Review comments at @bench/profile/probe-profile-01.mjs:
- Around line 25-28: Update arg so an absent flag still returns undefined, but a
present flag fails when its operand is missing or starts with a dash; apply the
same validation to the matching arg parser in the profile validator.

Review comments at @bench/profile/server-profile-contract.mjs:
- Around line 615-621: Update the array branch in valueChunks to recursively
serialize each element instead of passing the entire element to JSON.stringify,
preserving JSON’s null representation for undefined, functions, and symbols.
This ensures nested comparator rows are emitted in bounded chunks while keeping
the serialized output unchanged.

Review comments at @bench/profile/server-profile-runner.mjs:
- Around line 62-71: Update captureServerMachine to fail before registration
when the cgroup CPU resource contract is unavailable: require a nonempty cpu.max
value and verify captureServerLoad returns nonnegative safe-integer values for
usage_usec, user_usec, system_usec, nr_periods, nr_throttled, and
throttled_usec. Reuse the validated cpu.max value when building identity.

Review comments at @browser/fixtures/packed-recipes.d.ts:
- Around line 1-12: Add declarations for mountCardMotion, mountCompositorSheet,
mountCompositorPager, mountReorder, mountReact, and mountSolid to the
packed-recipe artifact type boundary, matching the signatures exported by
scope-recipes.mjs. Keep the existing declarations unchanged so browser scenarios
resolve these exports without relying on @ts-expect-error.

Review comments at @browser/fixtures/scope-recipes.mjs:
- Around line 25-27: Before extracting the tarball into packageRoot in the
scope-recipes fixture, remove that directory recursively and forcefully, then
recreate it as currently done; add rmSync to the node:fs imports.

Review comments at @browser/presence-transition.spec.ts:
- Around line 99-100: Combine the two dynamic imports of
/browser/.artifacts/scope-recipes.js in the presence-transition test into one
import that destructures both createPresenceTransition and animate.

Review comments at @test/behaviors-late-callback-owner.test.ts:
- Line 21: В тесте с `requestFrame` передавайте в `matchMedia` результат вызова
`reduceMedia`, а не саму фабрику, чтобы при `reduced=true` проверялся синхронный
путь `_settle` без кадров.

Review comments at @test/benchmark-methodology.test.ts:
- Around line 475-487: Update the temporal-oracle test setup in the it.each
block to use each case’s duration for both config.durationMs and
evidence.topology.durationMs, so positions and validator inputs match. Rename
the 256ms case to describe its non-overlapping windows, and verify the expected
outcomes for all four cases.

Review comments at @test/profile-measurement.test.ts:
- Around line 238-255: Update the test that launches probe-profile-01.mjs to run
it from a temporary clean clone, reusing the clean-clone setup from the test
near line 55. Keep the existing failure-artifact and digest assertions, and
clean up the temporary clone and output directory afterward.

Review comments at @test/resource-actual-package-retention.test.ts:
- Line 10: Update the resource retention test’s cleanup around afterAll to
remove the evidenceRun directory under EVIDENCE, or place EVIDENCE in a
temporary directory that is cleaned after the test. Preserve the test’s existing
evidence collection behavior while ensuring artifacts do not remain after each
run.

review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr
